channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Elfrid Payton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Elfrid Payton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Elfrid Payton
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Thibodeau on why he's sticking with Elfrid Payton:

“You look at the game, you look at what’s going on, it’s a 2-point game, and it comes down to a loose ball. So get out there, get the job done, play defense, run the team. We’re going to use everyone.”

Tom Thibodeau on Elfrid Payton, May 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Elfrid Payton, Immanuel Quickley
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Thibs on picking Payton over Quickley:

“It's a compilation of things. It’s how things have gone in practice, the games, the way the groups play with each other. And starting has never been as important as finishing for me. But we’ll be looking at the different combinations.”

Tom Thibodeau on Elfrid Payton, Immanuel Quickley, Dec 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: David Fizdale on Elfrid Payton
item.description:
And he's gotten praise from Fizdale and others for his play in camp.

“I thought (Payton) and Frank both did an excellent job of organizing us (in Saturday's intrasquad scrimmage), pushing the pace, defending, making plays for other people. They both did a really good job of that,”

David Fizdale on Elfrid Payton, Oct 6, 2019. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Elfrid Payton
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on impact for him when Elfrid Payton returns:

“My whole life I’ve been a combo guard. To have him back and take over the quote-unquote point guard position, it’s huge, because he’s really good at it, the way he can get into the paint and see things in the paint.”

Jrue Holiday on Elfrid Payton, Nov 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Jrue Holiday, Elfrid Payton
item.description:
Anthony Davis on Jrue Holiday and Elfrid Payton:

“I feel like we have the best backcourts in the game. Those two guys on the ball is ridiculous... just seeing it live and getting a chance to play for real (at Houston) when it matters, it was fun to watch.”

Anthony Davis on Jrue Holiday, Elfrid Payton, Oct 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Elfrid Payton, Julius Randle
item.description:
Anthony Davis on Julius Randle:

“He’s very physical. He can shoot better than I thought. Plays hard all the time... He wants to make the playoffs for the first time, along with Elfrid. You just kind of fall in love with guys like that, because it’s going to make you better.”

Anthony Davis on Elfrid Payton, Julius Randle, Oct 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Elfrid Payton
item.description:

“The starting unit with Elfrid Payton last year was one of the best in the league and showed a lot of really good signs early in this season before Elfrid went down,”

Frank Vogel on Elfrid Payton, Nov 9, 2017. Source: ESPN.
